name: weekly-roster
title: Weekly roster
for_each: select l.id, l.name || ', week of ' || to_char((date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 7, 'DD Mon YYYY') as name from locations l where exists (select 1 from shifts s where s.location_id = l.id and s.status = 'published' and s.on_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 7 and s.on_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 14)

sections.title: The roster
sections.note: Published shifts only. Post it where the team reads it; the notice window starts when they can see it.
sections.sql: select to_char(v.on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(v.starts_ts, 'HH24:MI') as starts, to_char(v.ends_ts, 'HH24:MI') as ends, coalesce(v.area, '') as area, coalesce(v.staff, 'OPEN' || coalesce(': ' || v.role_needed, '')) as who, v.break_minutes as break_mins from v_shifts v where v.location_id = $1 and v.status = 'published' and v.on_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 7 and v.on_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 14 order by v.on_date, v.starts_at, v.area

sections.title: Who to call
sections.sql: select st.name, st.role, st.phone from staff st where st.status = 'active' and exists (select 1 from shifts s where s.staff_id = st.id and s.location_id = $1 and s.status = 'published' and s.on_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 7 and s.on_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 14) order by st.name

name: timesheet-summary
title: Timesheet summary
for_each: select st.id, st.name || ', ' || to_char(current_date - 13, 'DD Mon') || ' to ' || to_char(current_date, 'DD Mon YYYY') as name from staff st where exists (select 1 from timesheets t where t.staff_id = st.id and t.on_date >= current_date - 13 and t.clock_out_at is not null)

sections.title: Hours worked
sections.note: The payroll handoff: approved rows are confirmed hours (Employment Relations Act 2000 s 130 record). This document states hours, never pay.
sections.sql: select t.ref, to_char(t.on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, coalesce(t.site, '') as site, to_char(t.clock_in_at, 'HH24:MI') as clock_in, to_char(t.clock_out_at, 'HH24:MI') as clock_out, t.break_minutes as break_mins, round(t.worked_minutes / 60.0, 2) as worked_hours, t.status from v_timesheets t where t.staff_id = $1 and t.on_date >= current_date - 13 and t.clock_out_at is not null order by t.on_date

sections.title: Totals
sections.sql: select count(*) as sheets, round(sum(t.worked_minutes) / 60.0, 2) as total_hours, round(sum(t.worked_minutes) filter (where t.status = 'approved') / 60.0, 2) as approved_hours, sum(t.break_minutes) as total_break_minutes from v_timesheets t where t.staff_id = $1 and t.on_date >= current_date - 13 and t.clock_out_at is not null

name: leave-record
title: Holiday and leave record
for_each: select st.id, st.name from staff st where exists (select 1 from leave lv where lv.staff_id = st.id)

sections.title: Leave on record
sections.note: The holiday and leave record the Holidays Act 2003 s 81 requires be kept. Balances and pay live in payroll.
sections.sql: select lv.ref, lv.type, to_char(lv.starts_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as from_day, to_char(lv.ends_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as to_day, lv.days, lv.status, to_char(lv.requested_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as requested, coalesce(to_char(lv.decided_on, 'DD Mon YYYY'), '') as decided, coalesce(lv.note, '') as note from v_leave lv where lv.staff_id = $1 order by lv.starts_on
